suggested_improvements: [LAYOUT] Problem: Top 'Primase' label and 'RNA Primer' label render at the same spot (B2), producing unreadable overlapped text next to the primase circle.; Solution: Line 45: self.place_at_grid(primase_label, 'A1', scale_factor=0.6) to sit directly above the primase circle at B1 (color #9B59B6), and self.place_at_grid(rna_primer_top_label, 'C2', scale_factor=0.6) so the orange (#E67E22) primer label sits one row below its primer bar, clearing both the primase label and the template line.

[LAYOUT] Problem: On the lagging strand the 'RNA Primer' label (D2) collides with the first 'Okazaki' label (D3), and both crowd the template line.; Solution: Line 78: self.place_at_grid(rna_primer_bottom_label, 'E2', scale_factor=0.6) moving it one row below the primer bar (still within 1 grid unit), keeping 'Okazaki' labels at D3/D4 and 'Sealed' at D3 unobstructed.

[LAYOUT] Problem: 'DNA Pol' labels overlap the 'Template' labels on both strands (top at A4, bottom at E4), with the bottom polymerase circle covering the 'Template' text.; Solution: Line 102: self.place_at_grid(template_top_label, 'A6', scale_factor=0.6) near the top template's right end, and self.place_at_grid(dna_pol_bottom_group, 'F2', scale_factor=0.7) with its label at F3, leaving bottom 'Template' at E4 and top 'DNA Pol' at A4 fully separated.
